statement: Labour share (nonfarm business, 4-quarter average) in 2027 is >= 1 pp below 2025 (BLS Productivity & Costs, Q4 2027 release)
status_at_phase_end: Indicator not resolvable in 2024 (baseline year 2025 not yet observed). 2024 releases showed Bloc A nonfarm-business productivity growth of ~2% y/y with unit labour costs rising a little faster than or in line with prices; the labour share was roughly flat at a historically low level after the 2022 drop. A strong Q1 2024 unit-labour-cost rise (later revised to +8.5% annualised in the Sept-2024 NIPA update vintage) pushed the share up early in the year, followed by softer Q2-Q3 cost growth. No AI-attributable fall visible in 2024 data.

items.summary: Revised Q4 2023 release: Bloc A nonfarm-business productivity +3.2% (annualised), unit labour costs +0.4% in Q4 and +2.5% over four quarters; 2023 annual productivity +1.3%. Low unit-labour-cost growth relative to prices implied a slightly falling labour share at end-2023.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Fourth Quarter and Annual Averages 2023, Revised (2024-03-07, verified). Release reissued 2024-04-26 with notice of hours-worked errors 2019Q1-2023Q4, corrected in the 2024-05-02 release.

items.summary: Preliminary Q1 2024 release: productivity growth slowed to ~+0.3% (annualised) while unit labour costs rose ~4.7%, implying a rise in labour share in Q1 2024.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, First Quarter 2024, Preliminary (2024-05-02), which also incorporated the corrected hours data. Values from memory of release coverage; revised 2024-06-06 to productivity +0.2%, ULC +4.0% (also not verified this run).

items.summary: Revised Q2 2024 release: productivity ~+2.5% (annualised) with unit labour costs ~+0.4%, i.e. labour costs growing more slowly than prices and the labour share easing back in Q2.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Second Quarter 2024, Revised (2024-09-05); preliminary 2024-08-01 had productivity +2.3%, ULC +0.9%. Values from memory of release coverage, not verified this run. Later vintages (after the 2024-09-26 NIPA annual update) show Q2 ULC +2.4%.

items.summary: Preliminary Q3 2024 release (incorporating the annual national-accounts update): productivity +2.2% (annualised), +2.0% y/y; unit labour costs +1.9%. Updated history shows Q1 2024 unit labour costs +8.5%, Q2 +2.4%: labour share rose early in 2024 and was broadly flat thereafter.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2024, Preliminary (2024-11-07); quarterly table as reproduced in BLS The Economics Daily 2024-11-14 (verified via search snippet).

items.summary: Revised Q3 2024 release: productivity +2.2% unrevised; unit labour costs revised down to +0.8% (annualised), +2.2% y/y; real hourly compensation +1.6% y/y. Productivity outpacing real compensation slightly in Q3.
items.detail: BLS Productivity and Costs, Third Quarter 2024, Revised (2024-12-10, delayed from early Dec; verified via search snippet of release text and PDF Table A1).

items.summary: The indicator compares 2027 with 2025; neither period existed in 2024. The labour-share index is revised with each national-accounts update, so 2024-vintage levels are not comparable with later vintages. No comparable quarterly labour-share series exists for Bloc B.
items.detail: FRED PRS85006173 (current vintage, 2017=100) is a later vintage and is not used here (strict as-of rule). Bloc B NBS has no quarterly labour-share release.
